post_fragment_headers: seven destination headers (eight total with Fragment)
eight destination headers (nine total, deliberately ignored)

assessment.notes: Every accepted UDP datagram was sent as three raw IP fragments with fragment zero last and zero to eight application bytes in that fragment. A 16,384-entry LRU map retained a bounded 128-byte prefix as aligned 32-bit words and emitted exactly one legacy TX hash after all eight required payload words and the UDP length arrived. Destination Options, AH, and a seven-Destination-header chain after Fragment all passed. An eight-Destination-header chain exceeded the shared eight-header bound when Fragment was counted and emitted nothing. State expires after 30 seconds.
